'''MediCure Pharmaceuticals''' was a front company research facility for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] development of a cure for [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addiction. Located in the [[Ternion Building]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[MediCure Laboratories|facility]] was ransacked and the cure destroyed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
MediCure Labs appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is the site of the Imperial mission "Breaking the Cure" on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TOR" />
